scenes.visual: Title card: A Crescent in One Daughter.

scenes.tts: Two sisters sit side by side, and only one hears Notch. What makes the difference?
scenes.visual: Two touching sisters, one teal and one grey. The question appears as on-screen text.
scenes.narration: Two sisters sit side by side, and only one hears Notch. What makes the difference?

scenes.tts: The answer began with a mutant fly. In nineteen eighty-nine, Tadashi Uemura and colleagues studied embryos lacking the gene numb.
scenes.caption: The answer began with a mutant fly. In 1989, Tadashi Uemura and colleagues studied embryos lacking the gene numb.
scenes.visual: Name card: Uemura and colleagues, 1989. A fly embryo outline with the word numb crossed out.
scenes.narration: The answer began with a mutant fly. In 1989, Tadashi Uemura and colleagues studied embryos lacking the gene numb.

scenes.tts: They worked in the laboratory of Lily and Yuh Nung Jan.
scenes.visual: Name card: the Jan laboratory.
scenes.narration: They worked in the laboratory of Lily and Yuh Nung Jan.

scenes.tts: In these embryos, the sensory neurons were transformed into the support cells of the same lineage.
scenes.visual: Body-wall sense organs: neuron outlines are replaced by support cells.
scenes.narration: In these embryos, the sensory neurons were transformed into the support cells of the same lineage.

scenes.tts: They isolated the gene. That showed numb chooses between sister fates. But it did not show how.
scenes.visual: A gene icon labelled numb. Caption: chooses between sister fates. How? remains on screen.
scenes.narration: They isolated the gene. That showed numb chooses between sister fates. But it did not show how.

scenes.tts: In nineteen ninety-four, Michelle Rhyu, Lily Jan and Yuh Nung Jan stained dividing precursors with an antibody to Numb.
scenes.caption: In 1994, Michelle Rhyu, Lily Jan and Yuh Nung Jan stained dividing precursors with an antibody to Numb.
scenes.visual: Name card: Rhyu, Jan and Jan, 1994. A dividing sensory organ precursor under a stain.
scenes.narration: In 1994, Michelle Rhyu, Lily Jan and Yuh Nung Jan stained dividing precursors with an antibody to Numb.

scenes.tts: In this method, an antibody marks the protein, and a DNA dye shows the stage of mitosis.
scenes.visual: Two colour channels: the antibody signal and the DNA dye showing condensed chromosomes.
scenes.narration: In this method, an antibody marks the protein, and a DNA dye shows the stage of mitosis.

scenes.tts: Numb was at the membrane. It lay in a crescent on one half of the cell.
scenes.visual: A gold crescent appears under the membrane on one half of the dividing cell.
scenes.narration: Numb was at the membrane. It lay in a crescent on one half of the cell.

scenes.tts: When the cell divided, Numb went into one daughter only.
scenes.visual: The furrow cuts; the gold crescent ends up in one daughter.
scenes.narration: When the cell divided, Numb went into one daughter only.

scenes.tts: In the scheme they used, that daughter is the inner precursor. Its sister makes the hair and socket.
scenes.visual: The gold daughter is labelled inner precursor; its sister is labelled outer precursor, with hair and socket below it.
scenes.narration: In the scheme they used, that daughter is the inner precursor. Its sister makes the hair and socket.

scenes.tts: Now two tests. First, remove numb from the precursor and its descendants. What cells form?
scenes.visual: Prompt card: Remove Numb. The four-cell tree with every cell blank.
scenes.narration: Now two tests. First, remove numb from the precursor and its descendants. What cells form?

scenes.visual: Hold on the prompt. A small timer icon.

scenes.tts: Four outer support cells, and no neuron or sheath.
scenes.visual: Reveal: the tree fills with four socket-like outer support cells. No neuron, no sheath.
scenes.narration: Four outer support cells, and no neuron or sheath.

scenes.visual: Hold on the reveal.

scenes.tts: Second, make extra Numb only during the precursor's division, so both daughters inherit it. What forms now?
scenes.visual: Prompt card: Give Numb to both, at the first division only. Both daughters of the first division turn gold; the extra Numb pulse ends before the later divisions.
scenes.narration: Second, make extra Numb only during the precursor's division, so both daughters inherit it. What forms now?

scenes.visual: Hold on the prompt. A small timer icon.

scenes.tts: The change goes the opposite way. Both daughters take the inner branch.
scenes.visual: Reveal: both daughters are labelled inner precursor.
scenes.narration: The change goes the opposite way. Both daughters take the inner branch.

scenes.tts: Each then divides as an inner precursor does. You get neurons and sheath cells, but no hair or socket. So there is no bristle.
scenes.visual: Each inner precursor divides normally. The tree fills with neurons and sheath cells. The bristle drawing has no shaft and no socket.
scenes.narration: Each then divides as an inner precursor does. You get neurons and sheath cells, but no hair or socket. So there is no bristle.

scenes.visual: Hold on the reveal.

scenes.tts: Opposite changes from loss and gain are strong evidence that a protein decides between two fates.
scenes.visual: Side by side: loss gives all outer cells; gain gives all inner cells. Arrows point in opposite directions.
scenes.narration: Opposite changes from loss and gain are strong evidence that a protein decides between two fates.

scenes.tts: Numb decides between the two branches.
scenes.visual: The two branches of the tree, outer and inner, with a gold Numb tag at the fork.
scenes.narration: Numb decides between the two branches.

scenes.tts: Now line this up with the Notch map. Numb goes into the inner precursor. That is the Notch-off daughter.
scenes.visual: The Notch table from chapter two appears. The gold Numb daughter lands on the grey Notch-off cell of row 1.
scenes.narration: Now line this up with the Notch map. Numb goes into the inner precursor. That is the Notch-off daughter.

scenes.tts: So does Numb tell the cell what to become? Or does it only stop the cell from hearing Notch?
scenes.visual: Two thought bubbles over the gold daughter: an instruction note, and a blocked Notch receptor.
scenes.narration: So does Numb tell the cell what to become? Or does it only stop the cell from hearing Notch?

scenes.tts: Numb forms a crescent and goes into one daughter: the one that does not hear Notch.
scenes.visual: Takeaway card: the Numb daughter is the Notch-off daughter.
scenes.narration: Numb forms a crescent and goes into one daughter: the one that does not hear Notch.

scenes.visual: Hold on the takeaway card.
